headline: MOUAVANG86 CUT TYLER SHOUGH AND HE IMMEDIATELY WENT 32.96 💸🤡

sections.heading: THE $6 QUARTERBACK 🏷️
sections.body:
Last week mouavang86 started Tyler Shough and Shough gave him MINUS 0.16 points. Fair enough. So on Wednesday at 6:53pm he cut him loose. 👋

Twenty-three hours later YMVtheDAD put in a $6 waiver claim. Six dollars. Shough then went out and scored 32.96, the second-best quarterback performance of Week 6, and YMVtheDAD won by 18.57. 🚀

mouavang86 scored 120.53 and won anyway, which is the only thing saving him from a worse paragraph. But somewhere in there is a lesson about patience, and nobody in this league is going to learn it. LOL.

sections.heading: KEENENG BENCHED 55.84 POINTS. AGAIN. 🪑
sections.body:
Keeneng scored 71.98 and lost by 24.27. His bench scored Trevor Lawrence 35.34 and Kyle Pitts 20.50. 💀

He left 37.66 points in sweatpants, which made him the only team in the league this week whose best lineup would have won the game: optimal 109.64, Tonglue's actual 96.25. Not close. A W was sitting right there in a folding chair.

The part that elevates this from a bad week to a genuine condition: he benched Lawrence (25.74) and Pitts (12.70) in Week 5 too. Same two guys. Two weeks running. And he started Juwan Johnson at tight end for a clean 0.00 to make room. Derrick Henry chipped in 4.50, so even the guys he picked on purpose let him down. 🥺

sections.heading: THE COLTS DEFENSE IS A CURSED OBJECT BEING PASSED AROUND 👻
sections.body:
You may remember the Indianapolis defense from last week, when it scored MINUS 2.90 for Hvang94 and he won by 0.66 anyway. Hvang94 apparently did not find that funny, because on Wednesday he dropped them for Corey Kiner. 🗑️

KevinVang picked them up, dropping the Bears to do it. The Colts rewarded him with MINUS 0.85. Pair that with Nick Folk's 1.00 at kicker and KevinVang got a combined 0.15 points out of two starting roster spots, then lost by 24.56 with Christian McCaffrey going 26.20 for nothing. 🪦

Hvang94, meanwhile, replaced them with the Panthers for 7.60 and posted the top score in the league. The curse is real and it has a forwarding address.

sections.heading: IMBACKBEECH DID EVERYTHING RIGHT AND LOST BY 36.83 🧘
sections.body:
Four teams played a mathematically perfect lineup in Week 6 — Hvang94, mouavang86, Evz132 and imbackbeech. Three of them won by 24 or more. 📊

imbackbeech scored 68.97. His optimal lineup also scored 68.97. There was not one point of improvement available to him anywhere on his roster, and he still got run over by 36.83. His leading scorer was the Kansas City defense at 15.15, ahead of every human being he started. 😭

He churned seven transactions this week chasing a fix — Butker, Brissett, Royals, McLaughlin, Estime, Chism, Sampson — and the answer was that there wasn't one. Sometimes the lineup isn't the problem. Sometimes it's just the roster. 🫠

sections.heading: ONE AT 5-1, SIX AT 3-3, AND A VERY LONELY BASEMENT 📈
sections.body:
Hvang94 is 5-1 and alone in first, and this week he finally earned it: 131.30, the best score in the league, with nothing left on his bench. The team is still named Not good, Just lucky, and the name is getting harder to defend. 👑

Behind him, three at 4-2 (ChunckyM, cvang1990, YMVtheDAD) and then a six-team traffic jam at 3-3: imbackbeech, Tonglue, mouavang86, Tub89, Evz132, KevinVang. ChunckyM has the most points in the league (698.62) and is still looking up at a guy who was eighth in scoring a week ago. 😵

muahuavang is 2-4 and has now absorbed 720.34 points against, the most in the league by fourteen points. He scored 96.34 this week, which beat seven teams, and lost. And VangMushu is 1-5 and alone at the bottom with the league's lowest PF at 539.40 — exactly 159.22 behind ChunckyM, or roughly a week and a half of football he never got to play. 🪦

sections.heading: THE FULL FOURTEEN: EVERYBODY GETS A TURN 🎤
sections.body:
Ranked by what you actually put on the board in Week 6. Your record does not protect you in here. 📋

1. Hvang94 — 131.30, won by 35.57. Drake Maye went 29.80, Kenneth Walker added 26.90, and Chris Boswell's 17.00 beat seven of the fourteen teams' best running back. Perfect lineup, top score, 5-1 — and he was still awake at 2:29 on Sunday morning adding Roschon Johnson off the street, who promptly started and scored 13.50. 👑

2. mouavang86 — 120.53, won by 24.56. Bhayshul Tuten's 22.70 led the way and the Steelers defense put up 15.85, which is more than Patrick Mahomes managed (10.48) — a sentence that should cost somebody a draft pick. Also a perfect lineup, which is the cruelest possible context for having cut Tyler Shough four days earlier. 💸

3. YMVtheDAD — 114.91, won by 18.57. The $6 Shough claim went 32.96, Germie Bernard chipped in 20.20, and a free-agent kicker in Chase McLaughlin hit 17.00. Beautiful week, except his two actual running back slots produced MarShawn Lloyd 1.00 and Rhamondre Stevenson 3.60 — 4.60 combined, which is a rounding error wearing two jerseys. 🧮

4. cvang1990 — 107.17, won by 47.45. Biggest margin of the week, built on Isaiah Likely 20.90, Aaron Rodgers 20.02 and Chuba Hubbard 18.60. He also left 22.40 on the bench, including the Jaylin Noel he personally signed on Friday for 18.70 and Rachaad White's 13.70 — when you win by 47 nobody checks, but we checked. 🔍

5. Evz132 — 106.94, won by 38.64. Jordan Love 22.24, Jonathan Taylor 20.10, Tyler Bass 17.00, zero points left on the bench. The one blemish: he fished Austin Ekeler out of YMVtheDAD's garbage on Saturday and started him for 1.70. Some trash is just trash. 🗑️

6. ChunckyM — 105.80, won by 36.83. Josh Allen 22.30, Jaxon Smith-Njigba 19.40 and Matthew Golden 19.40 is a real core, and he leads the league in points scored at 698.62. His two running back slots combined for 11.00 — Kimani Vidal 5.50 and Chris Rodriguez 5.50, perfectly balanced, equally useless — while Luther Burden's 13.50 watched from the bench. ⚖️

7. muahuavang — 96.34, LOST by 18.57. Bryce Young went 23.84 and Malik Nabers 22.50 and it bought him absolutely nothing, because even his optimal lineup (101.04) loses this game. Travis Kelce's 7.30 was the quiet killer. He has now been outscored by 720.34 points on the season, the most in the league — at this point it's not variance, it's a haunting. 👻

8. Tonglue — 96.25, won by 24.27. Michael Penix came off the wire for nothing and dropped 29.10, James Cook added 22.80, and the win was never in doubt. He also started Cam Skattebo for a pristine 0.00 while Alvin Kamara (13.90) and Blake Corum (13.00) sat — 29.00 points left on the bench, the second-most of anybody, in a game he won comfortably. Some people are just rich. 💰

9. KevinVang — 95.97, LOST by 24.56. Christian McCaffrey's 26.20 and DeVonta Smith's 17.00 deserved a real supporting cast instead of Nick Folk (1.00) and the cursed Colts (-0.85). He also spent $15 of real FAAB on Makai Lemon and benched him for 3.40, which is the most expensive 3.40 in the league this week. 💳

10. Tub89 — 95.73, LOST by 35.57. C.J. Stroud's 28.98 and D'Andre Swift's 21.00 were genuinely good and genuinely wasted. He started Keaton Mitchell for 0.40 and Kalif Raymond — a receiver he signed himself this week — for 2.80, with RJ Harvey's 13.10 benched. Three starting spots produced 16.30 between them. 🩹

11. Keeneng — 71.98, LOST by 24.27. Trevor Lawrence 35.34 and Kyle Pitts 20.50, both in street clothes, both benched for the second straight week. Matthew Stafford's 20.88 was fine; Juwan Johnson's 0.00 at tight end was not. The only blown game in the league this week and it wasn't even a close call. 🪑

12. imbackbeech — 68.97, LOST by 36.83. A flawless lineup — not a single point available on his bench — and his best player was the Chiefs defense at 15.15. Jacoby Brissett gave him 6.92 at quarterback and Harold Fannin 1.40 at tight end. You cannot coach your way out of this; you can only wait. 🧘

13. VangMushu — 68.30, LOST by 38.64. Jayden Daniels scored 25.00, which was 37 percent of his entire team's output, and everything after him was a rumor. He paid $7 — the second-highest winning bid of the week — for Tyler Higbee off Hvang94's scrap pile and started him for 2.20, while Keon Coleman's 13.90 sat. At 1-5 with 539.40 points, the rebuild is now just called life. 🪦

14. jayvang100 — 59.72, LOST by 47.45. Lowest score in the league, and the Jaguars defense went MINUS 4.40 while Brandon Aubrey kicked 1.00 — negative 3.40 from two roster spots, a genuine achievement. Bijan Robinson managed 6.30. And for the second week in a row he benched Brock Purdy (19.36) to start Dak Prescott (13.02), which has stopped being a mistake and started being a relationship. 🧢
